payload.abstract: This challenge aims to encourage the exploration of robust methods for locating heart beats in continuous long-term data from bedside monitors and similar devices that record not only ECG but usually other physiologic signals as well, including pulsatile signals that directly reflect cardiac activity, and other signals that may have few or no observable markers of heart beats. Our goal is to accelerate development of open-source research tools that can reliably, efficiently, and automatically analyze data such as that contained in the MIMIC II Waveform Database, making use of all relevant information.
